rationale: Plan maintains the task specification while correcting two critical methodological issues identified in self-review. (1) Target threshold is now computed on training data only, ensuring strict train-test separation and preventing performance metric inflation from test-set leakage. (2) Removed billed_amount and allowed_amount from features to eliminate information leakage; the model now relies exclusively on clinical and operational characteristics (claim type, diagnosis, place of service, provider specialty, service patterns, authorization flags, DRG information, and service units) that are available at claim intake, fulfilling the early-warning objective. All other parameters unchanged: 25% test split, preprocessing fitted on training data only, standardization for logistic regression, random forest for robustness, and standard caveats.
changes_summary: Two high-severity findings corrected: (1) target_definition.threshold_source changed from 'all_data' to 'train_only' to enforce train-test separation and prevent test-set leakage in threshold computation; (2) feature_set.features reduced from 15 to 13 columns by removing 'billed_amount' and 'allowed_amount', eliminating information leakage from target-correlated amount fields and ensuring the model functions as an early-warning system using only claim-intake-time information.
